line: Backend platform with databases, login, file storage and functions.

free.text: 2 GB storage; pauses after 7 idle days, deletes after 90

cells.metered: $25/month Pro; usage and native SQL can add charges

sql.math: $25 base plan. Database reads, writes, storage and bandwidth fit within the stated allowances.
The $25 base plan still applies to an idle project, because hosting is not billed down to zero.

files.math: $25 base plan. 100 GB of storage and 100 GB of transfer fit within the published allowances of 150 GB and 2 TB.

jobs.math: 10,000 executions, each one second long, fit within the 750,000 free executions a month. Other project usage is not included.
